description: This file defines the HelpConfigService class within the OrangeHRM Help plugin, responsible for retrieving configuration values related to help processor class and help URL. It extends the core ConfigService class and provides specific methods to access help-related configuration parameters.

classes.name: HelpConfigService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to fetch help configuration settings such as processor class and help URL, extending the core configuration service.

methods.name: getHelpProcessorClass
methods.description: Returns the configured help processor class name as a string.

methods.name: getBaseHelpUrl
methods.description: Returns the configured base URL for help as a string.
